name: @pipeworx/mcp-biotech-news

tools.name: biotech_news
tools.description: Latest biotech and pharmaceutical industry news headlines: FDA drug approvals and rejections, clinical trial results and data readouts, biotech M&A and licensing deals, venture funding rounds, layoffs and restructurings. Aggregates Fierce Biotech, Endpoints News, BioPharma Dive, STAT biotech, Fierce Pharma and GEN in one call, merged newest-first. Filter by keyword (e.g. "approval", a drug or company name) and a trailing day window.

query.description: Keyword filter over title/summary, e.g. "FDA approval", "obesity", a company name.

days.description: Only items published in the last N days (default 7).

source.description: Restrict to one source id (from biotech_news_sources), e.g. "endpoints".

tools.name: biotech_news_sources
tools.description: List the biotech & pharma news publications aggregated by biotech_news (id, title, source site, focus). Pass an id as `source` to biotech_news to read one publication.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-biotech-news forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the biotech-news pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
